synthesis.body: loop-cohort's canonical plan hash normalizes whitespace only, so ANY plan.md content edit after `approve-plan`/`schedule` — including flipping the Status line to Executing — breaks the wave-guard hash and stops `wave-complete`. Sequence discipline: (1) `schedule` requires tasks as `### T<n>` headings, so convert the task list BEFORE the approval pair; (2) do not touch plan.md between approve-plan and the final `review record`; (3) flip plan Status to Done only at finish, after the last cohort verb. Recovery from a broken baseline: cohort-only reset + re-init with the same run-id (engine history survives).

title: plan.md is byte-pinned from approve-plan until the run's final cohort verb
